anchor_note: Duel day boundary and week anchor as observed in game on 2026-10-25 - Day 1 Radar Training was in progress with 21h22m left at 21:37 local, and the week timer read 5d 21h. Day 1 therefore started 2026-10-25 19:00 local. Correction 2026-11-03 (issue #242): the boundary is an absolute 24 hour cycle from the anchor, 02:00 UTC daily, so the local wall time shifts with daylight saving - 19:00 PDT before the 2026-11-02 DST end, 18:00 PST after (the 2026-11-03 18:07 PST panel already showed the new Age of Science day with 23:52 left). Do not read day_boundary_local as a fixed wall time year-round. Scoring enriched 2026-10-25 from the Last War Handbook VS guide and Packsify via the research brief; per-day in game theme pages govern where they differ (Day 1 already read).

actions_that_score: complete and claim radar tasks (+30,000 each as displayed in game; Handbook lists 10,000 on days 1, 3 and 5 - in game value governs, delta test pending)
use stamina (+375 per point, in game)
use drone parts (+6,250 each, in game)
world map gathering (+50 per 100 food, 100 iron, 60 coin as displayed; radar gathering tasks excluded)
chip chests (+2,812.5 per premium chip material, in game)
days.gate: Radar release day (odd day). Complete and CLAIM everything in the radar, special pins included, early in the day. Claims score today (+30,000 per task as displayed in game). Wait out the roughly 5 minute dead window after the roll (18:00 PST / 19:00 PDT) before claiming.

actions_that_score: building power gained on collecting finished upgrades (Handbook 10 pts per power point - to verify in game on the day)
UR trade truck dispatched (Handbook 100,000 each)
Legendary secret task completed (Handbook 75,000 each)
survivor recruitment (Handbook)
days.gate: Building day. Collect finished building upgrades today (gift wrapping). UR truck dispatches score (Handbook 100,000 each) and Legendary secret tasks score (75,000) - trucks go UR today, contracts permitting. Radar - complete tasks but do NOT claim (odd-day claim rule); keep storage headroom under the cap.

actions_that_score: research power gained (Handbook 10 pts per point)
valor badges spent on duel research (Handbook 300 each)
drone component chests opened, this day only (Handbook L1 1,100 to L7 810,000)
radar task claims (Handbook 10,000 each)
days.gate: Science day. Research completions land today; valor badges are spent only inside today (owner decision); drone component chests score only today (owner inventory). Radar claims score again today - release the stack built on Day 2.

actions_that_score: hero EXP (Handbook 1 pt per 660 EXP; in game Radar day showed a 2.5 rate for a 660 batch - verify on the day)
legendary hero shard (Handbook 10,000 each)
epic shard 3,500, rare shard 1,000 (Handbook)
skill medals (Handbook 10 each)
recruitment tickets (Handbook - Elite Recruit 1,500 per use)
days.gate: Hero day. All hero consumables (EXP, shards, skill medals, recruitment tickets) are spent today and no other day - the owner spends them; a run flags the day. Radar - complete but do not claim.

actions_that_score: troop training and promotion per unit, tier scaled (Handbook T10 110)
building and tech power gains
all speedup types if the owner uses them
radar task claims (Handbook 10,000 each)
days.gate: Mobilization day - everything counts, including radar claims and promotions. Release the radar stack built on Day 4. Waterfall promotions (pre-trained low tiers promoted step by step) are the efficient training pattern; barracks stay full.

actions_that_score: defeating rival alliance troops, tier scaled (Handbook T10 55 per unit)
other map kills and healing at low rates (Handbook)
UR trucks and Legendary secret tasks (Handbook, variable)
days.gate: Enemy day, worth 4 win points. Combat is owner-led; a run does not attack outside the standing truck plunder rule. UR trucks and Legendary secret tasks also score. Radar stacking resumes - complete, do not claim, keep headroom.

Off day (settlement). Stack radar for Day 1 (complete, do not claim; never sit at the cap across a 6 hour refresh). Power freeze caution - matchmaking assesses alliance power before the new week; do not collect finished upgrades during the Sunday assessment window where avoidable.
